title: teaching
text:
Research Themes

1. Causal Inference and Methodological Development
I develop and apply causal inference methods to address complex questions in observational and experimental studies. My methodological interests include:

Causal mediation analysis
Time-to-event outcomes
Target trial emulation
Longitudinal data analysis
Methods for reducing bias in health research




2. Health Equity and Representativeness in Research
A central focus of my work is understanding and improving equity in health research participation and evidence generation.
My research examines:

Representation of underserved populations in health studies
Selection bias and participation bias
External validity and generalizability of research findings
Recruitment and retention strategies to improve equitable participation




3. Cancer Epidemiology and Survival Analysis
My doctoral research focused on causal mediation analysis of time-to-event outcomes in the context of intersectionality in breast cancer.
My work integrates:

Epidemiologic study designs
Survival analysis
Causal diagrams (DAGs)
Mediation analysis
Intersectionality approaches

title: teaching
text:
Current Projects

Mapping Representativeness in Youth Mental Health Research
This scoping review examines how representativeness is defined, assessed, and addressed in youth mental health studies.
The project aims to identify methodological gaps and provide guidance for improving equitable research practices.



Causal Mediation Analysis for Time-to-Event Outcomes
Developing statistical approaches for understanding mechanisms linking exposures, mediators, and health outcomes when outcomes are time-dependent.

title: Teaching
text:
Teaching Approach
My teaching approach combines:

Conceptual Understanding
I emphasize understanding why statistical methods work rather than only memorizing formulas.


Practical Application
Students learn through hands-on analysis using statistical software, particularly R, and real-world datasets.


Inclusive Learning Environment
I aim to create an environment where students from diverse backgrounds feel supported in developing quantitative skills.
